top_story.headline: No new FEC compliance filings surfaced since the last edition
top_story.dek: All 102 RFAI and Form 99 filings in the three-day window were already reported in earlier editions.
paragraphs: The FEC filing scan covering October 27 onward found 102 RFAI and Form 99 filings, and every one was already reported in a prior edition. No new RFAIs, Form 99 correspondence, terminations or red-flag keyword hits turned up.

The voided and negative transaction check found no new rows of $10,000 or more. That check was incomplete: the FEC's itemized-transactions query timed out (HTTP 504), so the absence of voided-transaction rows should not be read as confirmation that none exist.

sections.headline: $82,941 in new independent expenditures
paragraphs: 1 new independent expenditures of $50K or more, $82,941 in all. Largest target: Ashley Hinson Arenholz (support, $82,941).

blocks.text: Independent expenditures of $50K+ reported since 10/27/2026 (24/48-hour notices plus regular reports), counting only items not shown in an earlier edition. A shared vendor is a coordination-risk flag, not proof: FEC rules allow common vendors behind a firewall. Generic platforms (ActBlue, Google, postal, banks, broadcasters) are excluded.

footer.coverage_window: FEC filings received October 27, 2026 onward, checked on Friday, October 30, 2026 (PM edition). 102 filings in the window, all previously reported; 0 new.
footer.sources: FEC filings API; FEC Schedule A/B itemized transactions.
footer.known_gaps: The FEC Schedule A query for voided and negative transactions of $10,000 or more (loaded since October 27, 2026) failed with HTTP 504 (query timed out), so voided and negative transactions for this window could not be checked.

apod.title: Haunting the Cepheus Flare
apod.caption: Spooky shapes seem to haunt this dusty expanse, drifting through the night in the royal constellation Cepheus. Of course, the shapes are cosmic dust clouds visible in dimly reflected starlight.
